items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Hazel Scott... appeared there... [INTERVIEWEE] Yma Sumac played there.

ctx.x: And then they didn't allow the musicians to gamble in there at all. And then they had a concert room where Hazel Scott, Maurice Chevalier and all, they appeared there at the same time, in the concert room.
